text: {"rulings": [{"id": "1", "relation": "supersedes", "reason": "The runtime moved from Node 20 to Node 24 as of 28 May; a deployment cannot run on both versions at once, so the Node 20 claim is dead."}, {"id": "2", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The dev server port and the Node runtime version are independent settings; both can be true together."}, {"id": "3", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "TypeScript as the language and Node 24 as the runtime coexist without conflict."}, {"id": "4", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Deploying to Fly.io says nothing about which Node version runs there; both hold at once."}, {"id": "5", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The database schema being settled has no bearing on the Node runtime version."}]}
